pr_title: Consider most visible SectionsContainer section as selected one
pr_body:
Idea from here: https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/10990#issuecomment-735449612 with a slight modification. If the most visible section has a section before it that's 100% visible, consider that one selected instead.

Opening PR as draft because I honestly couldn't explain how better or not this is from what we have right now. This would fix #9196 though which was the goal (recording lagged a bit, sorry): 
![settings-new](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11320483/100645271-1a2f4e80-3345-11eb-899e-4eba3f99271e.gif)
pr_comments: I think this is ready for review. Can't find anything else to change besides the typo in comment here (should be large sections): https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/7ff3ffaaf17285f508dc545804fce196ce86c9e3/osu.Game/Graphics/Containers/SectionsContainer.cs#L241-L243

This is an especially bad case that remains:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/102574930-57615200-4135-11eb-85ad-f629026331e9.mov

You click a button then drag one pixel and are now in a new section.

Should be all fine now that scroll target is 20%

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11320483/102636369-3a407980-415d-11eb-81a1-185f2e3cecb2.mp4
This still doesn't work. Make a tall window and click buttons and it doesn't go to expected section.

> Make a tall window and click buttons and it doesn't go to expected section.

Seems to work for me:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11320483/102896921-db864300-446f-11eb-8896-5154ff21c4e6.mp4
It's great that it works for you, but it doesn't for me, which is why I reported it. My window was roughly 1280x1440 to reproduce issues.
There must be something else wrong for you, there is nothing in code that would make a difference on different window sizes (at least not anything that I can think of)
Just going to close this PR for now then. Let me know if you have interest in fixing it up. I think it will be faster for me to write a fix for this from scratch as a separate PR.

issue_context.title: Settings menu button click not highlighted correctly
issue_context.body:
![osu_2020-06-03_10-56-32](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/48766178/83617127-eedfc880-a588-11ea-9297-2d8d50396772.jpg)

When clicking a section button in the settings menu, the game scrolls to the section, but the button is not highlighted. When changing the ScrollTo definition in SectionsContainer.cs to
`public void ScrollTo(Drawable section) =>
            scrollContainer.ScrollTo(scrollContainer.GetChildPosInContent(section) - (FixedHeader?.BoundingBox.Height ?? 0), false);
` 
to disable the animation of the scroll, the problem doesn't occur, implying that somewhere in the scrollTo definition of the framework (probably, I cant find it), UpdateAfterChildren is run before the scroll animation ends, which causes the Update to highlight the section before the correct
comments:
It’s even worse on vertical device/small UI scaling
![IMG_0238](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42269909/83621115-8bf13000-a58e-11ea-9c80-d70ce46b5a77.png)

review_comments: honestly this feels wrong, and doesn't match stable. why aren't we centering the target instead? will that simplify things?
It won't really be more simple, it will just be different. There will be other edge cases you would need to consider if the sections are scrolled to middle

Actually, if we were to scroll to middle, then an algorithm other than visibility is probably the best. You would probably want to select the section intersecting with the middle line, which might be easier to do changing the old code. The edge case would come from big sections that won't fit on screen and would still need to be scrolled to the top, and from the bottom of the screen where there might be several sections that can never reach the middle but should still be highlighted if clicked on.

Yeah, it would probably need to scroll the start of the section to have the start of the section sitting at around 25% of the vertical height of the settings container (rather than the precise centre of the section). I'm not sure if stable already does this or not.
if you do continue work on this, remove this complete code. this should be possible with <10 loc. i cannot understand any of this.
